title: First Choir Lock: Gate Wound
description: First Choir Lock unfolds across choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs, pushing a one active deity Empyrean deity to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. without violating established Realm canon. Appearance rule: Radiant Hierarchies is the source culture humans later copied as angelic hierarchy and heavenly myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometry, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
lore: This mission treats Radiant Hierarchies as the origin behind angelic hierarchy and heavenly myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometry, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs; source-culture appearance layer: choir vault ascents, bell platforms, ophanim wheel lanes, throne-judgment stairs, living scroll seal floors, glass-light bridges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: seraph bell-edict blades, opal-glass cherubim aegis, ophanim many-eye choir cores, wheel intercept silhouettes
